statement.zh: 太阳月亮金字塔长期项目以发掘报告与门户持续公布莫切礼仪中心研究（Uceda/Castillo tradition；project web）。
statement.en: Huacas de Moche long-term project continuously publishes research on the Moche ceremonial centre (Uceda/Castillo tradition; project web).

statement.zh: 西潘在文献中作为莫切精英墓葬发现的关键案例讨论（Alva orientation；Quilter 2010）。
statement.en: Sipán is discussed as a foundational Moche elite tomb discovery case (Alva orientation; Quilter 2010).

statement.zh: 圣何塞德莫罗以莫切女祭司等精英葬仪闻名，见于 Castillo–Uceda 项目传统。
statement.en: San José de Moro is known for Moche priestess and other elite mortuary contexts in the Castillo–Uceda project tradition.

statement.zh: Bourget 2006 等研究讨论莫切仪式与献祭图像—考古（University of Texas Press tradition）。
statement.en: Bourget 2006 and related work discuss Moche ritual and sacrifice in image and archaeology (University of Texas Press tradition).

statement.zh: 埃尔布鲁霍复合体（含曹维耶老金字塔）是奇卡马谷地莫切礼仪中心指针（Quilter；Bourget）。
statement.en: El Brujo complex (including Huaca Cao Viejo) is a Chicama Valley Moche ceremonial-centre orientation (Quilter; Bourget).

statement.zh: Larco 衍生的莫切 I–V 阶段标签仍广泛使用，但政治统一性与绝对年代争论开放（Donnan；Lockard；Quilter）。
statement.en: Larco-derived Moche I–V phase labels remain widely used, but political unity and absolute dating debates are open (Donnan; Lockard; Quilter).

statement.zh: Chapdelaine 等讨论太阳月亮金字塔周边的莫切城市居住考古。
statement.en: Chapdelaine and colleagues discuss Moche urban residential archaeology around Huacas de Moche.

statement.zh: 综合著作将莫切表述为秘鲁北岸早期中间期多中心政体传统，而非单一帝国必然（Quilter 2010；Castillo–Uceda）。
statement.en: Syntheses frame Moche as an Early Intermediate Period north-coast multi-centre polity tradition rather than a necessary single empire (Quilter 2010; Castillo–Uceda).
